title: Mutating a published Texture2DRD's texture_rd_rid from a CompositorEffect callback invalidates dependent material uniform sets ("Uniforms were never supplied for set (3)")
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.6.1.stable.mono (Metal / Forward+).
- Source trace verified against 4.6-stable [89cea143987d564363e15d207438530651d943ac](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/89cea143987d564363e15d207438530651d943ac).
- Not yet tested in: earlier 4.x releases or newer development snapshots.

### System information

Godot v4.6.1.stable.mono - macOS Tahoe (26.3.1) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M4 Max (Apple9) - Apple M4 Max (16 threads) - 128.0 GiB memory

The reported path is the RenderingDevice Forward+ renderer (Metal backend on this hardware). The root cause is in the platform-independent renderer (`MaterialStorage`, `Texture2DRD`, `RenderForwardClustered`) so it should also reproduce on Vulkan / D3D12, but that has not been verified.

### Issue description

Reassigning `Texture2DRD.texture_rd_rid` on a wrapper that has been published as a `global uniform sampler2D` value, when the reassignment happens **inside a `CompositorEffect` render callback**, recursively invalidates dependent material uniform sets after the renderer's per-frame dirty-resource flush has already run. The next draw that uses any of those materials reports:

```text
ERROR: Uniforms were never supplied for set (3) at the time of drawing, which are required by the pipeline.
   at: draw_list_draw (servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:5026)
```

The error fires once per affected material draw, every frame, indefinitely. Materials only need to **declare** the global sampler in their shader (they do not need to actually sample it) to be marked as dependents and end up with set 3 unbound.

The same `texture_rd_rid` reassignment performed from `_process` on the main thread does **not** trigger the bug, because main-thread mutations are queued and run between frames at a safer point relative to `MaterialStorage::_update_queued_materials()`. The `CompositorEffect` callback path runs synchronously on the render thread, after the dirty-resource flush, so the queued material rebuild does not run before the next draw.

### Root cause

Verified by source-walking 4.6-stable. References below are to that revision.

1. `Texture2DRD::set_texture_rd_rid()` reuses the wrapper's RenderingServer texture RID across reassignments. The first assignment calls `texture_rd_create()` (creating a new shared RD view); subsequent assignments call `texture_replace()` on the same RS RID. See [scene/resources/texture_rd.cpp:75-104](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/4.6-stable/scene/resources/texture_rd.cpp).
2. `texture_replace()` frees the old shared RD view before copying in the new state. See [servers/rendering/renderer_rd/storage_rd/texture_storage.cpp:1602-1627](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/4.6-stable/servers/rendering/renderer_rd/storage_rd/texture_storage.cpp).
3. RD uniform sets carry dependencies on the RD texture RIDs they were built with. See [servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:4091](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/4.6-stable/servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp).
4. Freeing that RD texture recursively frees every dependent uniform set and fires their invalidation callbacks. See [rendering_device.cpp:6300](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/4.6-stable/servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp) and [rendering_device.cpp:6402](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/4.6-stable/servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp).
5. The material's invalidation callback only **queues** a texture-dirty material rebuild; it does not rebuild immediately. See [servers/rendering/renderer_rd/storage_rd/material_storage.cpp:2199](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/4.6-stable/servers/rendering/renderer_rd/storage_rd/material_storage.cpp).
6. Queued material updates are processed by `MaterialStorage::_update_queued_materials()` from `Utilities::update_dirty_resources()`. See [servers/rendering/renderer_rd/storage_rd/utilities.cpp:251](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/4.6-stable/servers/rendering/renderer_rd/storage_rd/utilities.cpp).
7. `RendererSceneCull::update_dirty_instances()` runs `update_dirty_resources()` **before** drawing viewports. See [servers/rendering/renderer_scene_cull.cpp:4133-4139](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/4.6-stable/servers/rendering/renderer_scene_cull.cpp).
8. `CompositorEffect` callbacks are dispatched synchronously inside the render path, **after** that dirty-resource phase. See [servers/rendering/renderer_rd/renderer_scene_render_rd.cpp:296](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/4.6-stable/servers/rendering/renderer_rd/renderer_scene_render_rd.cpp). Inside such a callback, `Texture2DRD::set_texture_rd_rid()` executes immediately on the render thread via `call_on_render_thread()`. See [servers/rendering/rendering_server_default.h:1177](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/4.6-stable/servers/rendering/rendering_server_default.h).
9. With the dependent uniform sets now invalidated mid-render, `RenderForwardClustered`'s draw loop checks `uniform_set_is_valid()` before binding set 3, finds it stale, and **skips the bind**. See [servers/rendering/renderer_rd/forward_clustered/render_forward_clustered.cpp:566](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/4.6-stable/servers/rendering/renderer_rd/forward_clustered/render_forward_clustered.cpp).
10. The pipeline still requires set 3, so RD validation fails at [rendering_device.cpp:5026](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/4.6-stable/servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp).

### Steps to reproduce

1. Download the four MRP files from https://gist.github.com/aleiby/079c47454b44c95d0a43f0533570c5f0 into a fresh directory and open it in Godot 4.6.1.
2. Run the main scene.
3. Observe a continuous stream of `Uniforms were never supplied for set (3)` errors in the **Debugger > Errors** tab, one per frame per affected material.
4. To verify the trigger requires the render-thread mutation: open `swap_effect.gd` and disable the effect (`enabled = false` in `_init`), then run again. Errors stop.
5. To verify it requires the global declaration in the material's shader: in `main.gd` change the shader code to remove the `global uniform sampler2D test_global_tex;` line. Errors stop.

### What is required for the bug

Verified by elimination in the MRP:

- A `global uniform sampler2D` declared in `project.godot` (under `[shader_globals]`).
- A `Texture2DRD` whose `texture_rd_rid` has been set, published as the global's value via `RenderingServer.global_shader_parameter_set`.
- A `CompositorEffect` whose `_render_callback` reassigns that wrapper's `texture_rd_rid` (calling `texture_replace()` internally and freeing the old shared RD view).
- Any `MeshInstance3D` (or `MultiMeshInstance3D`) using a `ShaderMaterial` whose shader declares the global sampler. The shader does **not** need to actually sample the global to be marked as a dependent.

### What is NOT required

- `SubViewport` (the bug fires with everything in the main world).
- `own_world_3d`.
- `MultiMeshInstance3D` (plain `MeshInstance3D` triggers it).
- `material_override` (a mesh surface material works).
- Actually sampling the global in the shader's `fragment()` (declaration alone is enough).
- A custom `render_mode` or `vertex()` function (though a custom `vertex()` doubles the error count by exercising the depth pre-pass too).
- Manually freeing the old RD RID after `texture_rd_rid` reassignment (`texture_replace()` already frees the shared view internally).

### Suggested project-side workaround

Treat published `Texture2DRD` wrappers as **immutable**. On every swap:

1. Create a NEW `Texture2DRD` for the new RD texture.
2. Publish it via `RenderingServer.global_shader_parameter_set(name, new_wrapper)`.
3. Retire the old `Texture2DRD` and its underlying RD RID through a small queue with a few-frame delay so that dependent material uniform sets have time to rebuild against the new wrapper before the old one's RD resources are freed.

This avoids `texture_replace()` entirely and lets the renderer's normal queued material rebuild path keep up with the swap.

### Related issues (not duplicates)

- [#80558](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/80558) — Global shader uniforms sampler2d not updating correctly in 4.1.1 (closed via [#80654](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/80654) for 4.2). Adjacent: same `RenderingServer.global_shader_parameter_set` API, but the bug there was that texture updates were not propagating; this report is the inverse — propagation invalidates dependent uniform sets too aggressively when the published value is a `Texture2DRD` being mutated mid-render.
- [#84482](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/84482) — `Texture assigned to TextureRdRid always invalid`. Adjacent: touches `TextureRdRid` assignment but the failure mode is a different one (wrong rendering device).
- [#103836](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/103836) — Discusses `Texture2DRD` and RD texture views / `rd_format_srgb`. Adjacent.
- [#96737](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/96737) — `CompositorEffect` in Mobile renderer producing a `set (0)` error. Different renderer path, different set, different cause; included only because the validation message is in the same family.

### Suggested engine-side fix

The renderer should not issue a draw with set 3 unbound when the pipeline requires it. Two possible directions:

1. When `Texture2DRD::set_texture_rd_rid()` runs from a render-thread callback, defer the `texture_replace()` until after the next material rebuild flush, or hold the old shared view alive until then.
2. In `RenderForwardClustered`'s draw loop, when an invalidated `material_uniform_set` is detected, force a synchronous material update (or fall back to the default material) instead of silently skipping the bind.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Full MRP files are available as a gist: https://gist.github.com/aleiby/079c47454b44c95d0a43f0533570c5f0

The MRP contains four files:

- `project.godot` — declares one `[shader_globals]` entry: `test_global_tex` of type `sampler2D` with empty value.
- `main.gd` — `Node3D` script that publishes a `Texture2DRD` to the global, attaches a `Compositor` carrying the swap effect to the camera, and adds a single `MeshInstance3D` whose shader declares the global.
- `swap_effect.gd` — `CompositorEffect` subclass whose `_render_callback` reassigns `target.texture_rd_rid` every frame.
- `main.tscn` — empty `Node3D` scene with `main.gd` attached as the root script.

`main.gd`:

```gdscript
extends Node3D

# Minimal reproduction for "Uniforms were never supplied for set (3)".
#
# Required ingredients (verified by elimination):
#   1. A global uniform sampler2D declared in project.godot
#   2. A Texture2DRD wrapping an RD texture, published as the global's value
#      via RenderingServer.global_shader_parameter_set
#   3. A CompositorEffect whose _render_callback reassigns that wrapper's
#      texture_rd_rid (which internally calls TextureStorage::texture_replace,
#      freeing the old shared RD view and invalidating any material uniform
#      sets that depended on it)
#   4. A ShaderMaterial whose shader merely DECLARES the global sampler
#      (does not need to use it), attached to any visible mesh
#
# Critical timing detail: the texture_rd_rid reassignment must happen on the
# render thread (inside a CompositorEffect callback). Calling the same
# reassignment from _process on the main thread does NOT trigger the bug,
# because main-thread mutations are queued and run between frames at a safe
# point relative to MaterialStorage::_update_queued_materials.

var _published: Texture2DRD


func _ready() -> void:
	_published = _make_texture2drd()
	RenderingServer.global_shader_parameter_set("test_global_tex", _published)

	var camera := Camera3D.new()
	camera.position = Vector3(0, 0, 4)
	add_child(camera)
	camera.current = true

	var compositor := Compositor.new()
	var swap_effect_script: GDScript = load("res://swap_effect.gd")
	var swap_effect: CompositorEffect = swap_effect_script.new()
	swap_effect.target = _published
	compositor.compositor_effects = [swap_effect]
	camera.compositor = compositor

	var proxy_material := ShaderMaterial.new()
	proxy_material.shader = Shader.new()
	proxy_material.shader.code = """
shader_type spatial;

global uniform sampler2D test_global_tex;
"""

	var box := BoxMesh.new()
	box.material = proxy_material
	var proxy := MeshInstance3D.new()
	proxy.mesh = box
	add_child(proxy)


func _make_texture2drd() -> Texture2DRD:
	var rd := RenderingServer.get_rendering_device()
	var fmt := RDTextureFormat.new()
	fmt.format = RenderingDevice.DATA_FORMAT_R32_SFLOAT
	fmt.width = 1
	fmt.height = 1
	fmt.usage_bits = RenderingDevice.TEXTURE_USAGE_SAMPLING_BIT \
		| RenderingDevice.TEXTURE_USAGE_STORAGE_BIT \
		| RenderingDevice.TEXTURE_USAGE_CAN_UPDATE_BIT \
		| RenderingDevice.TEXTURE_USAGE_CAN_COPY_FROM_BIT
	var bytes := PackedByteArray()
	bytes.resize(4)
	var rid := rd.texture_create(fmt, RDTextureView.new(), [bytes])
	var tex := Texture2DRD.new()
	tex.texture_rd_rid = rid
	return tex
```

`swap_effect.gd`:

```gdscript
extends CompositorEffect
class_name SwapEffect

# Reassigns a Texture2DRD's texture_rd_rid from inside a render-thread
# callback. This is the actual reproduction vector.

var target: Texture2DRD = null


func _init() -> void:
	effect_callback_type = EFFECT_CALLBACK_TYPE_PRE_OPAQUE
	enabled = true
	needs_normal_roughness = false


func _render_callback(_effect_callback_type: int, _render_data: RenderData) -> void:
	if target == null:
		return

	var rd := RenderingServer.get_rendering_device()
	var fmt := RDTextureFormat.new()
	fmt.format = RenderingDevice.DATA_FORMAT_R32_SFLOAT
	fmt.width = 1
	fmt.height = 1
	fmt.usage_bits = RenderingDevice.TEXTURE_USAGE_SAMPLING_BIT \
		| RenderingDevice.TEXTURE_USAGE_STORAGE_BIT \
		| RenderingDevice.TEXTURE_USAGE_CAN_UPDATE_BIT \
		| RenderingDevice.TEXTURE_USAGE_CAN_COPY_FROM_BIT
	var bytes := PackedByteArray()
	bytes.resize(4)
	target.texture_rd_rid = rd.texture_create(fmt, RDTextureView.new(), [bytes])
```
